field.name: gu_bona_fide_resident
field.comment: True if taxpayer meets bona fide resident test for Guam

field.name: gu_closer_connection
field.comment: True if taxpayer has closer connection to Guam than US

field.name: gu_days_present
field.comment: Number of days present in Guam during tax year (183+ required)

field.name: gu_files_with_drt
field.comment: True if taxpayer files with Guam Department of Revenue and Taxation

field.name: gu_files_with_irs
field.comment: True if taxpayer also files with IRS (partial-year or non-resident)

field.name: gu_has_tax_home
field.comment: True if taxpayer has tax home in Guam

field.name: gu_income_tax
field.comment: Calculated Guam income tax liability (mirrors federal)

field.name: gu_requires_form_5074
field.comment: True if taxpayer must file Form 5074 (income allocation)

field.name: gu_uses_federal_rates
field.comment: Guam uses mirror code (same as federal tax code)
